title: Industrial Agentic AI: LLM-Driven New-Generation Agents for Smart Manufacturing
authors: Lei Ren, Haiteng Wang, Shixiang Li, Jing Zhang, Yuqing Wang, Jingwei Guo, Yunfei Zhu, Yuanjun Laili, Yang Tang, Lihui Wang

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.26941）：Industrial Agentic AI 是综述，骨架清楚——先 'analyze five key challenges and discuss the concept and core characteristics of industrial agents'，再给 'a unified taxonomy covering application scenarios, embodiment forms, and five capability levels'，然后 'propose a four-layer system architecture and detail its core modules and operational mechanisms for closed-loop task execution'，最后过一遍工业生命周期各阶段的代表性应用与未来方向。价值路由：综述的价值在于坐标系而不是结论，它给的 '三维 taxonomy（场景 × 具身形态 × 五能力层级）' 与 '四层架构' 可以直接拿来给我们现有的 agent 能力分级用——尤其是 'five capability levels' 这种分级法，比我们现在 '即时/趋势/长尾' 的价值路由更接近能力成熟度维度，两者可互补。触发它的问题也很清楚：'dynamic environments, complex physical constraints, and stringent reliability requirements hinder the direct deployment of general-purpose agents'。证据边界：综述本身无新实验、无代码、无数据，全部结论依赖被引文献；五挑战与五层级的划分依据摘要未展开，无法核验其完备性；不涉及我们的主要领域（软件/工具链）。代码 / 项目页：待核验/暂无。
